objective: Review the native-parser adapter-payload to sidecar plan-resolution boundary and accept only the explicit-context, non-executing planning definition before any native-parser support, sidecar runtime handoff, RTL simulation, coverage-output equivalence, timing, arbitrary RTL/filelist support, automatic allocation, upstream regression success, or upstream landing claim.

review_decision.reason: The definition correctly prevents adapter payload alone from becoming a sidecar plan. It requires explicit target, mode, template or registry entry, and source gate or manifest context before any plan-resolution layer may call or mirror the existing sidecar stage-plan helpers.
review_decision.weakest_point: This is still only a reviewed boundary. No helper yet combines adapter payload with explicit sidecar context, no native parser path invokes sidecar_stage_plan, no sidecar handoff contract is produced from parser data, no runtime ABI changes exist, no RTL simulation runs through this path, and no coverage-output equivalence or timing evidence exists for a native-parser flow.
accepted_because: the adapter payload remains limited to parser-owned schedule values, ordinary Verilator args, and preserved build inputs
adapter metadata fields such as correctness_policy_ref and sidecar_owned_resolution_status are guard metadata only, not resolved plan data
target, mode, template identity, registry lookup, source gate or manifest reference, host-probe metadata, state/report paths, compare labels, and sidecar_handoff_contract remain sidecar-owned
filelists remain preserved input paths until an explicit reviewed sidecar policy or template source-closure gate authorizes expansion
correctness_policy_ref remains a later coverage_output_equivalence policy reference and is not CPU-vs-hybrid compare evidence
the definition does not call shim_report, sidecar_handoff_contract, synthesized Verilator command helpers, sidecar_operator_plan, efficiency estimation, execution, or timing paths

required_explicit_sidecar_context_before: source gate or manifest reference when coverage-output target selection needs one
conditional_context: template metadata for generated host-probe and state/report path rules

required_next_gate.name: implement_verilator_native_option_parser_sidecar_plan_resolution_fixture_gate
must_implement: an importable, non-executing helper that accepts the reviewed adapter payload plus explicit sidecar context
tests proving the helper rejects missing target, mode, and template or registry context
tests proving parser-owned fields are treated as constraints or preserved inputs, not source closure or target inference
tests proving filelists remain preserved input paths unless the explicit sidecar context names a reviewed source-closure policy
tests proving correctness_policy_ref stays reference-only and must match the later coverage_output_equivalence sidecar policy
tests proving the helper may call or mirror sidecar_stage_plan only after explicit context exists
documentation mention that this is plan-resolution fixture evidence, not native parser execution
must_not_do: infer arbitrary source closure or filelist dependencies
materialize state files from parser-only input
claim upstream Verilator regression success or landing
claim arbitrary RTL or arbitrary filelist support

non_claims: not a native Verilator parser implementation
not coverage-output equivalence for a native-parser flow
not a new public CLI or workflow
not parser inference of coverage manifests, host-probe metadata, source closure, state paths, or report paths
not automatic optimal GPU allocation for any design
not a runtime or ABI change
not GEM benchmark or comparison evidence
reports and artifacts are generated evidence, not source of truth
